status: frozen production implementation; no model development

rfdt_p.sampling: independent/product hypothetical sampling for the retained static tasks

hab22.starts: two fixed starts plus n_halton scrambled Halton starts; final package recommends --starts 24 and --individual-starts 4, but the output archive does not retain the executed historical CLI
hab22.participant_folds: R-compatible set.seed(123), recreated within context, 5 folds

architectures.participant_mixture: individual RFDT-P fits on training tasks; held-out task predictions averaged over eligible training participants from that task's context
architectures.pooled_restrictions: one shared parameter vector per crossed task-fold x participant-fold training intersection

choices13k.objective: unweighted problem-level MSE on aggregate bRate
choices13k.starts: two fixed starts plus 32 scrambled Halton starts per model/fold
choices13k.folds: seeded permutation then round-robin assignment to 10 problem folds
